purpose: Authorize exactly one final test-target opening and one evaluation pass for the four frozen model identities.
preconditions: RF and TGNN dataset gates are accepted and their exact full commit identities are recorded.
The immutable split counts and five-realizations-per-design invariant pass for both accepted datasets.
The four model-specific training outputs have passed their independent training gates.
The four selected configurations, preprocessing identity, environment identity, and fixed thresholds are recorded and hash-locked.
All five repeated-seed weights for each model identity are frozen and hashed; no candidate or final selection remains unresolved.
No test target file has been opened, parsed, loaded, or materialized before this authorization.
authorization_sequence: Create an append-only authorization record containing the four final model identities, source dataset manifest hashes, plan artifact inventory hash, and current implementation HEAD.
Verify the target-free sealed test indexes and confirm that no target-bearing test source is in the process memory or preprocessing inputs.
Keep the four frozen model specifications and fitted weights immutable; do not merge train and validation and do not refit.
Open the sealed test target sources exactly once in a dedicated evaluation process after authorization; load no test target before this point.
Evaluate RF classification, RF regression, TGNN classification, and TGNN regression in the frozen execution order using the fixed five-seed ensembles.
Write run-level predictions, design-level aggregates, all required metrics, uncertainty records where applicable, and hashes in one final evaluation record.
Close the test-target process and mark the test split consumed; do not rerun, retune, recalibrate, or replace any model based on the results.

evaluation_contract.classification_probability: average the five frozen seed probabilities, then apply 0.5
evaluation_contract.regression_prediction: average the five frozen seed predictions
evaluation_contract.metrics: use the complete classification and regression metric lists and design-level aggregation/uncertainty rules from the child policies
evaluation_contract.missing_or_failed_output: mark the final evaluation incomplete and preserve the frozen models; never use test results to repair it

post_opening_lock: Test results are read-only evidence. No model, configuration, preprocessing statistic, threshold, architecture, seed, or dataset may be changed after result opening.
